[[File:Moschovakis Schwichtenberg Troelstra.jpg|thumb|''From left:'' [[Yiannis Moschovakis]], Helmut Schwichtenberg, [[Anne Sjerp Troelstra]], 2002 at the [[Mathematical Research Institute of Oberwolfach|MFO]]]]
'''Helmut Schwichtenberg''' (born 5 April 1942<ref name="Elstrodt.Schmitz.2013">{{cite book | url=https://www.uni-muenster.de/FB10/historie/kapitel7.pdf | author=Jürgen Elstrodt and Norbert Schmitz | title=Entwicklung der Mathematik an der Universität Münster | date=Apr 2013 | contribution=Ehemalige Professoren 1945&ndash;1969 | pages=283 | language=DE}}</ref>) is a German [[mathematical logic]]ian.

Schwichtenberg studied mathematics from 1961 at the [[Free University of Berlin]] and from 1964 at the [[University of Münster]], where he received his doctorate in 1968 from [[Dieter Rödding]].<ref name="Elstrodt.Schmitz.2013"/><ref>{{cite thesis | type=Ph.D. thesis | url=https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/d32c/adc7d9b9a3bce0c43ad41c8789355c10a465.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191031223317/https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/d32c/adc7d9b9a3bce0c43ad41c8789355c10a465.pdf | url-status=dead | archive-date=2019-10-31 | author=Helmut Schwichtenberg | title=Eine Klassifikation der mehrfach-rekursiven Punktionen | trans-title=A Classification of Multiple Recursive Functions| institution=Universität Münster | year=1968 | s2cid=17197421 |language=DE }}</ref><ref>{{mathGenealogy|19415}}</ref> He then worked as an assistant and then as a professor in Münster,<ref name=25j>{{cite book|contribution-url=https://www.mathematik.uni-muenchen.de/festschrift/node117.html|contribution=Prof. Dr. Helmut Schwichtenberg|title=25 Jahre Fakultät für Mathematik Das Mathematische Institut 1971 – 1996: Jubiläumsfestschrift des Mathematischen Instituts der Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München|editor1-first=Rudolf|editor1-last=Fritsch|editor2-first=Rudolf|editor2-last=Hauber|publisher=LMU Munich|year=2000|access-date=2024-05-22}}</ref>  and since 1978 has been professor of mathematical logic at [[LMU Munich]]<ref name="Elstrodt.Schmitz.2013"/> (successor of [[Kurt Schütte]]). 

Schwichtenberg deals with, among other things, [[proof theory]], [[theory of computability]], [[lambda calculus]] and applications of logic in [[computer science]]. He is a member of the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=25j/>
